title: New Jersey Prosecutor Arrested for AI CSAM Production
excerpt: A New Jersey deputy attorney general has been arrested after a Discord user flagged the production of artificial intelligence CSAM.
body_html:
A New Jersey deputy attorney general has been arrested following allegations that they produced artificial intelligence child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Law enforcement officials stated that the arrest was initiated after a user on the Discord platform flagged the illicit content.

The suspect, identified by investigators as operating under the online username "thegentlemanpervert," was taken into custody as police responded to the alert generated by the platform user. Authorities continue to investigate the case involving the creation of illegal AI-generated imagery.
